real_qa.q: What new features has Daniel J. Lewis launched in Podgagement?
real_qa.r: Lewis recently launched a Teams feature in Podgagement that allows podcast network operators to invite cohosts and team members with different access levels and permissions. real_qa.q: What improvements are coming to PodChapters according to Daniel J. Lewis?

real_qa.q: Why is Daniel J. Lewis taking a hiatus from his podcast?
